item.title: U.S. And Israel At War With Iran (Updated)
item.description: The U.S. and Israel have begun a major military operation that is aimed directly at the regime, its nuclear ambitions and its ability to wage war in the future. The post U.S. And Israel At War With Iran (Updated) appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: U.S. Military Has Used Long-Range Kamikaze Drones In Combat For The First Time
item.description: America's clone of Iran's Shahed-136 had been used against Iran in an ironic vignette of modern drone warfare. The post U.S. Military Has Used Long-Range Kamikaze Drones In Combat For The First Time appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: B-2 Spirits Join Iran Air War, Pummel Underground Missile Caves (Updated)
item.description: The arrival of the B-2s marks a change in the air campaign and will put certain target sets at greater risk as the operation expands. The post B-2 Spirits Join Iran Air War, Pummel Underground Missile Caves (Updated) appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: America’s New PrSM Ballistic Missile Just Made Its Combat Debut
item.description: PrSM struck targets in Iran and can fly hundreds of miles further than its predecessor ATACMS. The post America’s New PrSM Ballistic Missile Just Made Its Combat Debut appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: U.S.-Israeli War With Iran Enters Day Two (Updated)
item.description: U.S.-Israeli strikes and Iranian retaliation continue amid new uncertainty with the death of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. The post U.S.-Israeli War With Iran Enters Day Two (Updated) appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Three USAF F-15E Strike Eagles Shot Down By Friendly Fire (Updated)
item.description: The F-15Es went down over Kuwait while flying Operation Epic Fury missions. The post Three USAF F-15E Strike Eagles Shot Down By Friendly Fire (Updated) appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Iran’s Key Naval Base On Strait Of Hormuz Set Ablaze From Strikes
item.description: The attack overnight on the port has left one of Iran's prized sea bases and at least one frigate on fire, with black smoke filling the air. The post Iran’s Key Naval Base On Strait Of Hormuz Set Ablaze From Strikes appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Friendly-Fire Incidents Are Nothing New In Modern Air Warfare
item.description: The loss of three F-15Es to friendly fire today is far from the first time similar combat accidents have happened in the post Cold War era. The post Friendly-Fire Incidents Are Nothing New In Modern Air Warfare appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: War With Iran Now In Its Third Day
item.description: The Pentagon has offered new details about the conflict as joint strikes with Israel, and Iranian retaliation, continue. The post War With Iran Now In Its Third Day appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Iranian Kamikaze Drone Boat Makes First Successful Strike Of War
item.description: Iran, a pioneer in lower-end uncrewed surface vessel technology, used at least one to attack the oil tanker MKD VYOM in the Gulf of Oman. The post Iranian Kamikaze Drone Boat Makes First Successful Strike Of War appeared first on The War Zone.
